newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Shanghai Commercial Bank FRCD increased.
newsitem.headline: HK's Shanghai Commercial Bank FRCD increased.

text.p: Shanghai Commercial Bank's floating rate certificates of deposit issue due April 2002 has been increased to HK$680 million from HK$600 million due to oversubscription, the arrangers said.
The five-year certificates were priced at par to float at 35 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. There are put and call option in year three.
With fees, the all-in return for co-arrangers is 40.5 basis points.
Arrangers, with HK$165 million each, are Commonwealth Bank of Australia and Societe Generale Asia.

Co-arrangers, with HK$50 million each, are Bank Austria's Hongkong branch, Berliner Bank, CoreStates Bank's Hong Kong, Kwangtung Provincial Bank's Hongkong branch, Sudwestdeutsche Landesbank's Singapore branch, Sin Hua Bank's Hongkong branch and Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK).
